comparison.objective: Wrap and tape pre-creased paper around a fixed gift box; candidate separates ceramic media from metal washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Folding and adhesive placement versus bimanual pouring, screen agitation, bridge clearing, and granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Covered, taped, released package versus ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no loss/damage, and screen released on supports for 3 s.
comparison.reason: No size-selective particle separation or aperture-flow outcome is tested.
